AC5 SATISFIED — apply complete, verified first-hand. All five ACs ticked; closing.

Change 1688 MERGED (submitted 2026-08-12 23:50:34, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1, confirmed against the Gerrit REST detail endpoint, not on a relayed claim).

The apply was run by the coordinator under the operator authorization recorded in the previous comment: 3 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed — matching the expected-plan contract exactly, with nothing touching the drift-detection or Bedrock roles. I did not run it and mutated nothing in AWS.

Rather than tick AC5 on the report alone, I confirmed the applied state with read-only describes:

  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names rebar-bridge-run-failures
    -> Namespace=rebar/host, MetricName=bridge_run_failures, Threshold=1.0,
       Period=3600, TreatMissingData=notBreaching, State=INSUFFICIENT_DATA
  aws iam get-role --role-name rebar-bridge-metrics
    -> arn:aws:iam::896586841071:role/rebar-bridge-metrics
  aws iam get-role-policy --role-name rebar-bridge-metrics --policy-name rebar-bridge-metrics-put
    -> single action cloudwatch:PutMetricData, Resource *, Condition StringEquals
       cloudwatch:namespace = rebar/host

Every value matches the committed HCL, and the role ARN matches the AWS_BRIDGE_METRICS_ROLE_ARN Variable that was set (region us-east-1).

ON THE INSUFFICIENT_DATA STATE — expected, not a fault, and worth recording so nobody 'fixes' it: no Reconcile Bridge run has published the metric yet. The alarm transitions to OK on the first pass that publishes a 0, which is precisely the reason the success path publishes 0 rather than relying on missing-data semantics. If it is STILL INSUFFICIENT_DATA after a few bridge runs, that is a real signal — it means the metric steps are being skipped (a Variable unset or misspelled) or the OIDC assume-role is failing, and the workflow run log for the 'Configure AWS credentials' step is where to look, since that step is continue-on-error and will not redden the run.

Residual visibility gap, by design and already owned elsewhere: notBreaching means this alarm cannot see a bridge that stops running ENTIRELY. That case belongs to the Reconciler Heartbeat Canary; the two are complements.
